# Overview

VONQ’s current operations relevant to the exit preparation involve multiple internal teams, notably finance, commercial/CRM, data/analytics, and senior leadership. These teams are actively engaged in supporting investor reporting and transaction readiness. The core systems in use include the Finance System, CRM, ERP, and the Qlik Warehouse, which serves as the primary data and reporting platform.

For analytics and reporting, VONQ relies on Qlik-based dashboards and reporting utilities, utilizing the Qlik Warehouse as the central repository for business data. The main data sources feeding these platforms consist of the Finance System, CRM, ERP, and legacy datasets that may be included to ensure a minimum of three years’ trended data. Excel-based datasets and external systems are also acknowledged, with their inclusion subject to feasibility and agreement.

At present, some source systems lack automated integration with the Qlik Warehouse, necessitating manual, one-off data ingestion. Where ongoing data refreshes are required throughout the sale process, a batch-based refresh process will be established. The Qlik Warehouse provides the foundational cloud infrastructure for all reporting activities. Additional recurring integrations and refresh procedures are anticipated for systems needing regular updates during the transaction phase.
